text:
anna-accounting: New invoice from HanRiver Labs attached (invoice_2026-03-19_HR.pdf). Net GBP 12,000, VAT 0.00. Vendor says "Korean withholding may apply; gross-up requested per contract". They attached a CoTR (Korean) and a brief note. Can tax/legal confirm steps? cc @josh-fin-ops

vendor-billing-bot: Invoice uploaded (inv_82345) and attachment CoTR_HanRiver.pdf

josh-fin-ops: Quick Q - which Redwood entity is paying? UK Ltd or Redwood Inc? AP needs correct tax treatment.

anna-accounting: PO EM-1199 paid by Redwood UK Ltd. SOW HR-SOW-09 referenced in vendor email.

mei-procurement: Contract has a gross-up clause similar to other suppliers but we need to validate whether Korean tax actually applies to cross-border services.

rachel-legal: Short version: if Korea requires withholding and vendor is non-UK resident, gross-up triggers only if contract obliges. Two actions: (1) get certified English translation of CoTR (we can't accept untranslated docs), (2) vendor confirmation of UK onsite days (if any). If CoTR proves Korean residency and tax law applies, calculate WHT and gross-up per clause. If no Korean WHT, treat as no withholding.

josh-fin-ops: For AP workflow: set flag TAX_REVIEW_PENDING. If vendor provides translated CoTR and confirms gross-up calc, AP will process a grossed-up payment. Otherwise we'll apply withholding and remit. Example calc (for illustration): net 12,000; WHT 10% = 1,200; gross-up payable = 1,200; total remitted = 13,200. We'll require vendor sign-off on amounts.

anna-accounting: Sent vendor message asking for: certified English translation of CoTR, statement of onsite UK days, and bank instructions confirming acceptance of gross-up. Pausing payment until docs received.

vendor-billing-bot: Vendor reply uploaded (hanriver_reply_2026-03-19.pdf) - vendor says they will provide translation by EOD and confirm dates.

mei-procurement: I'll also pull SOW and attach clause to the ticket for AP.

rachel-legal: Thanks. If translation shows valid CoTR for FY2025 and no UK PE, we can avoid Korean WHT in practice; but vendor still requests gross-up. We'll only pay gross-up if contractually required. Holding until translation + confirmation.

anna-accounting: Checklist: request translated CoTR (done), confirm onsite days (done), hold payment (done). Will update when translation is in. :white_check_mark:
